player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long Stratego.
Mipela i amamas long kisim flag bilong yu o rausim olgeta pisin bilong yu.
Mipela i putim army bilong yu long board, inklusiv flag, bomb, na arapela pisin bilong olgeta rang.

### Pasin bilong Pley
1. **Rul bilong Muvim:**
   - Long turn bilong yu, yu ken muvim wanpela pisin long wanpela step long adjacent square (antap, daun, kais, o raun) we i gat pisin bilong yu.
   - Eg: Wanpela pisin i ken muvim long A1 long B1 o A1 long A2 sapos B1 na A2 i no gat pisin bilong player yet.
   - Sapos yu chusim pisin i bomb o flag, yu no ken muvim.
2. **Pait:**
   - Sapos yu muvim long square we gat pisin bilong opisit, orait pait i kamap:
     - Pisin i gat rang i win na rausim pisin bilong opisit.
     - Sapos rang i wankain, tupela pisin i raus.
     - **Spesol Kes:**
       - Bomb i rausim pisin i atakim, tasol Miner i difusim bomb.
       - Spai i ken win long Marshal sapos Spai i atakim pastaim, tasol Spai i lus long arapela pisin.
3. **Gol bilong Strateji:**
   - Yu mas kilim pisin bilong opisit long muvim na pait.
   - Yu mas protektim flag bilong yu long kisim flag bilong opisit.
   - Yu ken usim Scout long ganim informesen long pisin bilong opisit na atakim pisin i weak.

### Pasin bilong Mekim Muvim:
1. Yu mas spesifim koordinet bilong pisin yu laik muvim na destiniesen.
2. Yu ken usim format: [A0 B0], we A0 i posisen bilong pisin, na B0 i destiniesen.
   - Eg: Long muvim pisin long row 0, column 0 long row 1, column 0, input [A0 B0].
3. Yu mas ensurim destiniesen i valid akording long rul bilong muvim.

### Notis bilong Importans:
- Board i soim pisin bilong yu na posisen bilong ol, eg MN, MS.
- Board i soim posisen bilong pisin bilong opisit tu, eg ?.
- Grid i gat ~ i lake na yu no ken muvim long en.
- Long sugestion, yu ken statim game bilong yu long muvim pisin i stap long front line long ganim informesen long pisin bilong opisit. Player 0 na player 1 i gat front line long row D na G rispektivli.

Hia i stap board state bilong nau:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Man i pilai {player_id} em i no putim wanpela move long dispela kain pasin olsem [A0 B0] .
invalid_move.invalid_coordinates: Invalid action format. Man {player_id} i no bin putim ol valid koordinet long en.
invalid_move.not_own_piece: Pasin i no stret. Pleia {player_id} mas goim wanpela pisi bilong em yet.
invalid_move.scout_through_pieces: Invalid action format. Player {player_id} i no ken putim wanpela skut long ol narapela piusen.
invalid_move.scout_diagonal: Invalid action format. Man i pilai {player_id} em i no ken surikim wanpela skut long diagonally.
invalid_move.non_scout_multi_square: Pasim i no stret. Ol pisi, ekseptim skaut, inap go wanpela skwea tasol long wan taim.
invalid_move.move_into_lake: Format bilong aksen i rong. Player {player_id} i no ken muvim long lake.
invalid_move.move_onto_own_piece: Dispela pasin i no stret. Man {player_id} em i no inap go long hap bilong em yet.
invalid_move.move_bomb_or_flag: Format bilong aksen i rong. Player {player_id} i no ken muvim bomb o flag.
